apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.2.0 — LoopLab navigation: tapping a song now PUSHES a song detail screen (waveform, transport, Loops/A–B/More) instead of expanding a player card inline; the library is a clean list again. Includes v1.1.3: transport above the tabs, waveform at 34% screen height, flat web-style loop chips with correct wrapping, and a Song title field in More.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Song detail push navigation + player layout fixes.
